body_lead: KOCHI: Kerala will be transformed into a national hub for artificial intelligence (AI) and emerging technologies, Chief Minister V D Satheesan said while inaugurating Naviq Technology, an AI company launched by IBS Software Group to drive innovation in the global travel industry, in Kochi on Thursday. “The world is witnessing an unprecedented explosion of knowledge, with AI rapidly becoming an indispensable tool. The CMO has already begun using an AI-powered dashboard to monitor the progress of investment projects in the state,” Satheesan said.
